book.name: Jone
book.title: JONE Gotena Pii Layene Epene Joneto Pepa Peleane Oko

content: Matiyato Wele Tunduma-pene Mindi Jisasana Kenenga Gae Leane Oko

Ole wataka angu pola-kola, Juta yame wandakali tupamane Pasopa tomo nalaini oto oko epolopeya nembo toto, Jisasa bala Betani tano okona pea. Tano okone akali Lasatosa wamba Jisasato malinga ika laya yane okonena yuu tene oko ya.
Jisasa bala epea-kola, wandakali minditupa-mane balana tomo yanga-maiyai. Lasatosapi, wandakali waka minditupapi, utupane Jisasa towa atu peteai-kola, wanda Matato tomo tupa tale pua maya.

Jisasa bala tomo no petea-kola, Matiyato wele tunduma-pene kapo lapo petene pene mindina awua epoto, Jisasana kenenga gae lo ayia maya. Wuane puato, Jisasana kenenga ipati peane oko Matiyato balana kawane itini-mane kunu apia maya-kola, wele okonena tunduma epene peane okomane anda okonena tawe ya. Wandakali minditupa-mane ita nata lene okona pini tupana ipane penge lo moto, wele tunduma-pene okonepene tupa waa peyai-kola, wandakali waka tupamane wele okonepene tupa muni kambua-mane kambalaini.

Jutasa Isaka-tiyote bala Jisasana disaipolo tupana mindi atoto teke, matili bala ene petea. Matiyato wele tunduma-pene okone Jisasana kenenga gae lo ayia maya-angi, Jutasato wandakali waka tupa tipa puato,
anu peakale wanda okomane wuane peyape. Balato wele oko nanima gipia-yale, nanimato wele okone salimi loto, muni kina andete tepo moto, katulo wandakali tipia tupa moyo maima-yale lea.

Balato pii leane okone wandakali tipia tupa nembo toto, nalea. Jia. Balato disaipolo tupana muni tupa ando atoto, minditupa pake miaka pua atalaepia. Tene okonena, balato wele okone nanima gipia-yale, nambato okone salimi loto, muni mialu, minditupa katulo pake miawa-yale nembo toto, wuane lea.

Wuane lea-kola, Jisasato bala lamawuato, ole dindi lo wandakali tipia tupa yakama towa atu atolopeyai tekeko, namba yakama towa ole dindi lo ata napulu-peyama. Wandakali-mane namba mali pulai-angi, wanda okomane wele okone nambana umbaininga gae lokale nembo toto, wele okone yatawa pitipia-ko. Andipa balato wele okone gae leya oko gae leakale lo nimbato ando kondaa lea.
Akali Lasatosa Oko Peyo Ome Lamakale Leaini Oko
Juta yame wandakali kambua-mane Jisasa bala Betani tano okona ateya lene oko ale wato, wamba balato Lasatosa malinga ika laya yane nembo toto, Jisasa, Lasatosa-la, okonelapo lapotaka andolo epeai.

Wamba Jisasato Lasatosa malinga ika laya yane nembo toto, Juta yame wandakali kambua-mane pitisa akali kawane tupa masia maiyu, Jisasa lo bilipi leai. Tene okonena, pitisa akali kawane utupane-mane Jisasa, Lasatosa-la, okonelapo lapotaka peyo ome lamakale nembo toto, pii lo yake peainipia.
Kiŋi Tupamane Palaini Pua, Jisasa Bala Jutusaleme Peane Oko

Gotena pii pepa pelene eya mindimane loto, Sayone tano okona tane wandakali yakama yuku aa na-piyapape. Yakamana kiŋi oko bala yia dongi andopane mindina masianenga pitiyu epeya oko andalapa layene eya. Gotena pii pepa pelene eya okonemane wuane layene yane pua teke, anate-lene Jisasa bala yia dongi andopane mindi ayia pua moto, okonena pitiyu, Jutusaleme poyale, asini pea. Asini pea-kola, Pasopa tomo noyale Jutusaleme peaini wandakali kambua-mane Jisasa epeya lene oko ale wato, utupane-mane ita pama kembone tupa yando moto, Jisasa asininga malanda olo epeai. Epoto, utupane-mane pii taimane loto, akali epeya oko bala Isatale tanena kiŋi oko ateya leai. Akali Andane Goteto bala epeakale leya-kola, bala epeya. Goteto bala moyo ateakale. Nanimato Gotena gene oko laiyu lamakale leai.

Wandakali utupane-mane wuane leai-angi, Jisasana disaipolo tupamane Gotena pii pepa pelene eya okone nembo tolo-peke naleai. Wuane tekeko, matili Goteto gene andane mindi Jisasa maya-angi, balana disaipolo tupamane mangene balato peane okola, pii wandakali utupane-mane leaini okola, okonelapo nembo tolo-peke loto, Gotena pii pepa pelene eya okone Jisasa andayo layene yane nembo teai.
Wamba Jisasato Lasatosa malinga ika laya wato, mali okona kamaka epeakale lea-angi, wandakali kambua bala towa atu atoto, andeai. Andoto, utupane-mane Jisasa balato wuane peane okone pii lo tawe yai.
Lo tawe yai-kola, Jisasato metekolo piape okone peane lene oko ale wato, wandakali kambua-mane Jutusaleme tepa alu, bala malanda olo peai.

Bala malanda yai-kola, Patasai tupamane yakama teke-teke mindi lamaiki puato, wandakali tupa pitaka-mane bala watama peyai oko andalapa. Wandakali-mane bala watama napeakale lo nanimato mangene peyama tupa katu naleya leainipia.
Gitiki Yame Wandakali Minditupa-mane Jisasa Andamakale Leaini Oko
Juta yame wandakali tupamane Pasopa tomo nalaini oto oko epea-kola, wandakali kambua Gote lo lotu loyale Jutusaleme peai. Wandakali utupanena minditupa Gitiki yame wandakali ateai.
Gitiki yame wandakali utupane-mane Galili disitiki tano Betesaita tane Pilipi ateanga epoto, akali andane, nanimato Jisasa andaima lakae lo nembo teyama leainipia.
Wuane leai-kola, Pilipi epoto, Endutu lamaiya-kola, Pilipi, Endutu-la, okonelapo-mane poto, Jisasa lamai-yapili.
Lamaiyapi-kola, Jisasato okone-lapona pii okone yano peyoto, Akalina Iwanane oko gene andane miape-pene oto oko wamba mandaka epeya lea.

Nambato pii enene wete mindi yakama langeyo. Witi dini mindi bala oma napene, mee andaka yando, dini lia napene, bala angu yalane tekeko, bala yuunga tepa wato, omeando, bala poka loto, dini kambua lialane.

Wandakali mindimane namba masia mawuato, yuu okona mangene piyamane tupa epelewa yamapane yo ateando, balato mangene utupane pua atapowa ateakale lo Goteto ando konda napulu-peya tekeko, wandakali mindimane yuu okona mangene piyamane tupa masia mawuato, namba epelewa yamapane yo ateando, matili bala saka atapowa atolopeya.

Wandakali mindimane nambana piape pua ateaindo, namba watama epeakale. Yakamato namba watama epeaindo, nambana Ayiane okomane gene andane mindi yakama gula-kola, namba atolowa yuu okonena yakama namba towa atu atolo-peyama. Jisasato wuane lea.
Jisasato Yakama Tii-pene Oko Lo Bilipi Lalapape Leane Oko

Wuane lalu, Jisasato pii minditupa tako pua loto, andipa kenda-pene andane mindi nambanga epoyale peya okonena, namba mini kenda wato, nembo kambua teyo lea. Nembo kambua toto, nambato aki loape. Ayiane, kenda-pene okone nambanga epolane nembo toto, nimbato asia pai laa loape. Jia. Nambato wuane na-lokale. Kenda-pene okone awuakale nembo toto, namba epewane.

Ayiane, nimbana gene oko andane eya lo andawa lape lea. Wuane lea-kola, pii layene mindi ati kenga atala epeane okomane loto, wamba nambato nambana gene oko andane eya lo andawa lewa. Matilipi, nambana gene oko andane eya lo dee lapone andawa lolopeyo lea.

Goteto wuane lea-kola, ongane mandaka gulo ateaini wandakali minditupa-mane pii okone kuai lo ale naene, ati kulu leya leainipia. Dee, minditupa-mane pii okone apito leyape lo nembo natene, enjole mindimane pii mindi Jisasa lamaeya leai.
Wuane leai-kola, Jisasato utupane lamawuato, Goteto pii lala okone nambato ale ola nalala lea. Jia. Yakamato ale alapale nembo toto, balato pii okone lala.
Andipa balato yuu okona wandakali tupa yapa lo tale puyale puato, yuu okona ando atalane sipitisa koo Satane oko peyo watoyale peya.
Matili akali minditupa-mane namba auwa aiyu lolai-angi, wandakali pitaka nambanga epeakale nembo toto, nambato utupane yoo lo molo-peyawa lea.
Akali minditupa-mane bala ita malamanda okona peyo yuka wato, bala auwa aiyu lolopeyai nembo toto, Jisasato wandakali tupa lamawuato, akali minditupa-mane namba awua aiyu lolopeyai lea.

Wuane lea-kola, wandakali amunguli peaini tupamane balana pii okone yano peyoto, akali mindimane Gotena pii pepa pelene eya tupa dii lea-kola, Mesaya oko bala matili-matilipi atapowa atolopeya oko ale ema leai. Bala atapowa atolopeya yando, anu peakale nimbato nanima languato, akali minditupa-mane Akalina Iwanane oko awua aiyu lape-pene eya lelepe. Akalina Iwanane okone bala apipe leai.

Wuane leai-kola, Jisasato utupane lamawuato, wandakali mindi bala undupi pangosa epoko pua ateando, bala onga peya lo anda napulu-peya lea. Tii-pene oko ole mindilapo angu yakama towa atu atolo-peyako. Matili undupi-lene okomane yakamanga yame peyolane nembo toto, tii-pene okomane mee tii pua ateya okone angi, yakama epoko pua atalapape.

Andipa tii-pene oko yakama towa atu ateya-angi, yakamato tii-pene okona andopane tupa atamakale nembo toto, bala lo bilipi lalapa lea. Jisasato pii okone lalu, wandakali amunguli peaini utupane tepa alu, bala yuu mindisa ata too pulu pea.
Wandakali Kambua-mane Jisasa Lo Bilipi Naleaini Oko

Wamba wete potopesa akali Aisayato Mesaya oko bala tai wete atolopeya nembo toto, Gotena pii minditupa pepa peleaipia. Balato pepa okone peyoto, wandakali-mane nambana piape tupa lee-mane andoto, nambana pii okona tene tupa kuai lo nembo toto, yamapane peke leaindo, nambato utupane mo atu yolo-peyawa leaipia. Wuane tekeko, wandakali utupane-mane yamapane peke naleakale nembo toto, Goteto utupanena lene minu undupi laya alu, utupane-mane balana pii okona tene nembo nateakale laya alu, piyane lo layene eya. Balana pii okone layene eya pua Goteto pea-kola, wandakali utupane-mane katulo Jisasa lo bilipi naleainipia. Wamba Aisayato Gotena pii waka mindi loto, Akali Andane okomane metekolo piape minditupa peane tekeko, apito bala tai wete ateya lo andeape. Nanimato wandakali tupa lamawuato, balato metekolo piape utupane piyane lema tekeko, apito nanimana pii utupane bilipi leape lo layene eya. Gotena pii layene okone enene guleakale nembo toto, Jisasato bala tane Mesaya oko ateya lo wandakali tupa andawa loyale metekolo piape kambua peane tekeko, wandakali kambua-mane balana metekolo piape utupane andoto teke, bala lo bilipi naleai.

Enene, Juta yamena akali kawane kambua-mane Jisasa lo bilipi leaini tekeko, Goteto yakamana gene tupa laiyu lapia lakae lo utupane-mane nembo nateai. Jia. Wandakali yangone-mane yakamana gene tupa laiyu lapiai lakae lo nembo teainipia. Tene okonena, Patasai tupamane akali utupane Juta yame wandakali waka tupa towa lotu naleakale lolaini lo yuku wato, Juta yamena akali kawane utupane-mane Jisasa lo bilipi leyama lo pana naene konda yai.
Nambana Pii Okomane Wandakali Tupa Yapa Lo Tale Pulupeya Leane Oko

Okone angi, Jisasato pii taimane loto, namba lo bilipi lolai wandakali tupamane namba angu lo bilipi nalolo-peyai lea. Utupane-mane namba ati kenga atala yuunga puu leane Ayiane oko lo bilipi lolai-kola teke pulupeya.
Dee, namba andolai wandakali tupamane namba ati kenga atala yuunga puu leane Ayiane oko andolai-kola teke pulupeya.
Namba lo bilipi lolai wandakali mindikipi mindi undupi pangosa ata napeakale nembo toto, namba ale tii-pene mindi gulo atoto, yuu okona epewane.

Namba yuu okona epewane oko yuu okona wandakali tupa yapa lo tale pulu na-epewane. Jia. Nambato utupane molo-peke lolo epewane. Wuaneko, wandakali-mane nambana pii oko ale wato, wato mina napeando, nambato bala yapa lo tale puato, koo tene mindi balanga yata na-olopeyo. Jia.

Namba tane wua lokale nembo toto, pii na-lalawane. Jia. Namba ati kenga atala yuunga puu leane Ayiane okomane pii utupa lape leya-kola, nambato pii utupane lalawane. Namba Ayiane okona pii okomane wandakali tupa saka atapowa ateakale lo ataya alane nembo toto, nambato balana pii okone ale wato, pii balato namba langeane tupa lalawane. Tene okonena, wandakali mindimane namba masia guato, nambana pii tupa mia napeaindo, yuu koyo pula-angi, nambana pii okomane wandakali okone yapa lo tale puato, koo tene mindi balanga yata olopeya. Jisasato wuane lea.
